description: Key paths in rigs/<rig_id>/rig.yml (installed as /etc/pancakebatter/rigs/<rig_id>.yml) other programs may rely on. Same rules as system_config.v1.stable_keys.json: '*' fans out over map values; additive changes stay in version 1; renaming or removing a key, or changing a derived rule, bumps schema.version. Every key here exists in every rig document; any physical value may be the string 'unknown', which a consumer must treat as undeclared, never as a default. Free text (description, mount_notes, evidence) is for people and may change.
